_about: Egg Farm Simulator [MODDED] (EFSR group, by SirMing) reference data. 'src' on an entry: discord = EFSR [REBORN] Discord update/patch logs and community posts; wiki = Egg Farm Simulator RBLX Fandom wiki (original game, values may differ in the 2018 re-creation); roblox = the game's Roblox listing.

game.name: Egg Farm Simulator [MODDED]
game.base: Re-creation of SirMing's Egg Farm Simulator, ~2018 version. Reborn, Modded and Sandbox update together (patch #7).

caps.note: Patch #8. Anyone over 250K was set to 250K. Earlier cap was 150,000 (patch #5).
Patch #8 raised the cap to 30%; growth plateaus after 25%. Hotfix: 31.2% after all upgrades.
Idol + Sound floor is 2; Hasty Hen sets 1 for 60 min.
Jump to Level 1 or your Best Level.

platinum.unlock: Ascend at farm level 300,000. Pending Gold Eggs count toward Platinum Eggs (patch #8).
platinum.costNote: Standard upgrades: n levels from current level L cost n x (2L + n + 1) / 2. Rebirth Boost: 2^(L+n) - 2^L. These match observed examples; not confirmed game source.

upgrades.name: Rebirth Cap Increase
upgrades.effect: Raises the rebirth cap, helping unlock higher Black Egg earnings.
upgrades.note: Menu shows MAX LEVEL 550; patch #8 says 'Rebirth Cap Increase egg is uncapped'. Check in game.

upgrades.effect: +2% Black Eggs per Prestige per level.
upgrades.note: Community feedback: its bonus may not compound. Kept low.

abilities.name: Fertilizer
abilities.effect: Each hit drops 1% of the chicken's eggs (0.1% on bosses). Decoyed: 2x.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.effect: Doubles the next ability you use.

abilities.name: Hamburger
abilities.effect: Removes 60 min from the last ability's cooldown. Modded: Decoy + Hamburger works again (double Decoy).

dealer.name: Hasty Hen
dealer.effect: 1 chicken per level for 60 min. Every 6h.

dealer.name: Deviled Egg
dealer.effect: +999% White Eggs for 60 min (was 666%). Once a day.

dealer.name: EGG9000
dealer.effect: Auto-progress to the next level until you go back, Retire or Rebirth.

dealer.name: Egg Basket
dealer.effect: Instantly gives about 15 min of White Eggs at your current DPS.

dealer.name: Timelapse
dealer.effect: Fast-forward based on your DPS. Modded tiers: 50 / 125 / 300 / 1K. Timeskip now kills each boss once.

dealer.name: Auto-Egg
dealer.effect: Permanent auto-attack (egg cannon), auto-train a hero, or auto-ability. Modded: auto abilities fire as soon as ready.

passes.name: VIP
passes.effect: +50% Eggs, daily Epic Box + 2,500 diamonds, chat tag and colour.

passes.name: Pet Chick
passes.effect: Pet that attacks about twice a second with your attack stats. Breaks idle. Toggle under Settings.

passes.name: Skip Retire
passes.effect: Robux or diamonds. Banks the pending reward and gives rebirth eligibility without resetting you.
